first_message.raw_markdown:
I've released the source for checkpoint 57586341, which scored 27.05. It uses Daniel Franzen's M2 gameplay policy; my changes concern entry lifecycle supervision and verification.

Source: https://github.com/Jayant-kernel/arc3-entry-lifecycle-release/tree/3418ffa20142a71e74cb1f01121874ecc66c0585

The attached archive contains the accepted entry, reproducibility pins, verifier and licence notices. MIT-0 applies to the original contributions identified in `LICENSE-SCOPE.md`; inherited components keep their existing terms. Credits include Daniel Franzen, Tufa Duck/TAAF, Qwen, Intel AutoRound, SGLang and FlashInfer. Model weights, vendor wheels and game content are excluded. Model/vendor prize eligibility remains unresolved.
